logs/l14-percent-in-listing|log:2|runlog.summary: Accepted difference. The original uses each listing row as a printf format string in the execution log (sim-ui 19 Q23): '100% sure: %d %x %%' came out as '100\xc8\x9bRure: 4730280 10 %' (stack contents). The port writes the row literally (engine/sim/PATCHES.md 11.7).

trap15-a/a31-files-zero-length|report|re.summary: Task 54 with D2 = 0: the original gives D0.W = 0 (the Borland fwrite returns the item count for a zero item size; trap15-a 12 item 14, task 54 'UNVERIFIED'); the port gives 2 (C99 fwrite returns 0). trap15-a says to special-case D2 = 0 to match. Task 53 with D2 = 0 gives 2 in both.

trap15-a/a32-files-bounds|report|result.summary: Task 53 with A1 = $2000 and D2 = $FFFFFFFF on a 10-byte file (the bounds test wraps): the original gives D0.W = 0 with D2 unchanged ($FFFFFFFF) and reads nothing (memory at $2000 unchanged) - the Borland fread returns the requested count; the port gives D0.W = 2. Measured under Wine (the RTL is in SIM68K.exe, the file system is Wine's); trap15-a 12 item 14.

trap15-a/a47-serial-without-port|report|.summary: Task 40 with CID 16: the original gives D0.W = 1 (invalid CID, checked in TsimIO::initComm before the port is opened; trap15-a 13 Serial); the port gives 2 because NullSerial.initComm (core/sim-host/serial/null.ts) returns 2 for every CID. CID 0 with a missing port (2) and tasks 41-43 on an unopened CID (3) agree.

trap15-b/b06-modes-above-15|report|resul.summary: Drawing modes 18-23 (trap15-b 15 V8): under Wine the official program draws the red pixel unchanged for every one of them (Wine's SetROP2 refuses the values the table yields and keeps the copy mode); the port follows trap15-b 5.4 (mode 20 gives white, mode 22 the inverse of the pen, ...).
trap15-b/b06-modes-above-15|report|resul.unconfirmed: run b06 on Windows (tests/conformance/windows-confirm/README.md). If Windows draws the pen unchanged as Wine does, SH1 (surface, the ROP2 table of trap15-b 5.4) changes modes 18-23 to keep the copy mode; if Windows follows trap15-b's table, this entry is a property of Wine and is removed by regenerating the golden on Windows.
